metadata.title: बस्तर में सरेंडर को आदिवासी कैसे देखता है |  Mass Surrender or Tactical Move? | Main Bhi Bharat
metadata.description: In a major development from the Bastar region of Chhattisgarh, 21 more Maoist guerrillas surrendered on Sunday, 26 October — taking the total number of surrenders to 231 so far. While the state government celebrates this as a success of its peace initiative, a faction of hardline Maoists has accused the surrendered cadres of betraying the movement and the people. Main Bhi Bharat brings you an exclusive ground report and an in-depth analysis by Editor Shyam Sunder, uncovering what this wave of surrenders really means for Bastar’s long-running conflict.
